tools.name: audit_repo_token_waste
tools.description: Static-analyze a public GitHub repo (owner/name) or a set of source files for LLM token waste: uncached static prompts, frontier models on extraction tasks, hot loops, non-deterministic repeat calls. Returns findings with fixes and an estimated recoverable percentage.

tools.name: optimize_prompt_payload
tools.description: Rewrite an OpenAI Chat/Responses or Anthropic Messages request body so its static prefix is provider-cacheable (Anthropic cache_control breakpoints, OpenAI prompt_cache_key). Returns the optimized body, what changed, the token profile and the projected per-request saving. Never changes the tokens th

tools.name: calculate_model_arbitrage
tools.description: Price a workload at list prices across models: cost per request and per month for the requested model, its cheaper sibling, and the effect of prompt caching. Pricing table version 2026-10-26.

tools.name: provision_workspace
tools.description: Create a TokenZero workspace and key with no form. Returns the key once, the base URLs that route through it (OPENAI_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL), the one-click dashboard link and the badge URL. Free up to the monthly free tier; nothing is billed.

tools.name: workspace_metrics
tools.description: Live value scorecard for a TokenZero workspace: hard savings and net ROI per window, the four engines' contribution, speed, parity, availability and privacy posture, per-model breakdown and one-click recommendations. Needs the workspace key (tz_live_…); pass demo: true for a labelled sample.
